purpose: Model hero placement independently from squad composition so positional and adjacency buffs can affect optimization without inventing unverified hero effects.

optimization.rule: Every five-hero composition must be evaluated over all 5! placements when at least one active effect depends on position, row, adjacency or relative placement.

geometry.note: Do not assume that the word adjacent in a skill maps to this generic graph unless the in-game skill text or a validated test confirms it. Explicit row/slot targeting remains safe.

effectSchema.productionRule: Effects marked needs-in-game-validation must not change a production recommendation by default. A verified structural effect may still require the player's current displayed value instead of guessing a curve.
effectSchema.timedRule: Timed effects may use average-uptime only as a research proxy until exact cast timelines are calibrated.

verifiedHeroEffects.condition: Mason is deployed; targets are Tank heroes occupying one of the three back-row slots.
verifiedHeroEffects.notes: Google Play confirms the structural back-row Tank monster-damage effect. WfGg uses the player's current displayed percentage instead of hard-coding a skill curve.

catalogNote: Sarah SSR/UR and non-positional timed support effects now live in hero-combat-effects.v1.json so variant logic is not duplicated here.
